# Review, pass 1 — kebra-nagast-ch100a

Checked: every grammatical label in every note against the form; original to `l` word by word; `l` against `i`; remembered English in `i`; house renderings and the published parts' glossary entries (ch. 2-8, 44, 62-63, 70, 73-75, 76a, 96a, 97 and known-forms.json); p flags; unit endings; `t` against the packet (identical, unchanged). 24 units; p:true on the heading and on the first unit of the single paragraph, as in the pilot. Totals: 0 major, 12 moderate, 17 minor (29 edits). Unit numbers are 1-based, as in the notes.

## Findings refused
- Unit 10 (ኢይገድፎ / ኢይሬስዮ are 3rd person, but i has "I will not forsake / make"): kept. The note discloses the shift of person; making i third person would put "he" inside God's "I made him" and read as a different speaker. l keeps the literal "he".
- Unit 10 length (51 words, no ፤ inside): kept whole; the source has no ፤ in the unit, and there is no mark at which to cut.
- Unit 23 ለእበድ "for folly (?)" and unit 23 "made for life": kept; the (?) is on folly, and "made for" is a small gloss of ለ-.
- ተኬነወ, ቀብጸ, ስላተ, ጠብዐ, ምክዕቢተ, ሐሰ, ይትፈጋዕ, ለሐከ, ሰዐመ readings: already marked (?) and stated as uncertain; I could not confirm any better reading without a modern translation, so none changed.
- Unit 21 (ወሶበ ... "and I made you from water and earth") clashes with unit 16: the note already says so and keeps (?); only "since" -> "when" changed.
- Paragraph marks: the source chapter is one paragraph; p:true on the heading and the first unit only, as in the pilot. Unit endings all at ። or ፤.

## For the glosser / second pass
- ተሀቦ: known entry is 2ms ("that you give him"); here it is 3fs (subject ሰማይ / ምድር). Broaden.
- ወትቤሎ: known entry is "she said"; here 2ms "you said". Broaden.
- ኢይብላዕ: known entry is the figurative "break, void"; here the plain "that he not eat". Broaden.
- ወተስዕረ: known "defeated, cast out (?)"; here with እም- "from your company". Fits; add the use if the entry is broadened.
- ሐመይዎ / ሐመይናሁ / ተሐምይዎ: lemma ሐመየ "slander", as published.
- ምኑነ: published entry (ወምኑነ) "rejected, despised"; reuse.
- Titles (`titleEn`, `part`, `about`) still say "Accused"; left, since they are our own naming of the action.

Unresolved (?) forms in units.json: ቀብጸ (u8), ስላተ and ተኬነወ (u10), አመስፈንኮ (u10), ኀጢአ (u11), ጠብዐ (u13), ተስዕረ (u19), ሰዐሞ and ለሐኮ (u5), ይትፈጋዕ (u6), ምክዕቢተ (u16), ኢያኅጣእኮ (u14), አጠየቆ (u12), ዐሊ (u21), ሐሰ and ለእበድ (u23), plus the unit 20-21 conditional.

# Review, pass 2 - kebra-nagast-ch100a

Checked: every gloss.json entry (lemma = Geʿez dictionary form, meaning and grammar against every place the form occurs, no invented modern forms), all nine `__broaden__` entries (each key is in known-forms.json and each value begins with the old entry whole + ' · '), consistency with known-forms.json for every other token (no token lacks an entry; no gloss key duplicates a known key; no gloss key absent from the text), and a re-skim of units.json (`t` unchanged). Dillmann is not at hand in this environment, so the readings below rest on the grammar and the parallel structure of the text. Totals: 0 major, 3 moderate, 3 minor (6 edits).

## Checked and fine
Lemmas, meanings and person/number for all other new entries fit every occurrence: ተዐደዉ, ተምዕዖሙ, ንትለአኮ, ያብርህ, ወነፍሐ, እምይእቲ, ጽሉአ, ተሐምይዎ, ወእሰምዐክሙ, ፈጠርክዎ, ኢሀሎ, ወኢይሬስዮ, ዘፈጠርከ (2ms), ኢኮኖ, ዘይረድኦ, ወመፍቀሬ (construct), አስሐቶ, ትትዔበዩ, እምኮንክሙ, ወእምአፈድፈድክሙ, ፍትነነ, ዐቂበ and the rest. All four broadened entries added by pass 1 (ተሀቦ 3fs, ወትቤሎ 2ms, ኢይብላዕ, ወተስዕረ) are covered; ተስዕረ's known entry already reads "cast out (?)" and fits.
